summary: Two blocks close this gap: a clearer FAQ answer and one new FAQ about the shutdown.

items.text: Carrier email-to-text gateways such as txt.att.net, tmomail.net and vtext.com are being shut down or limited. If your alerts used one, point the same email at your new text address instead: nothing else in your monitoring tool has to change.
items.detail: Replace the answer under the FAQ "Why did my email-to-text stop working?" so it says what to do, not only why.

items.text:
Verizon is shutting down vtext.com. What should we switch to?
Point the alerts that go to vtext.com at a business text address instead. Your monitoring tool, scheduler or alarm panel keeps sending email the same way, and the message arrives as a normal text on any carrier. Set it up before [March 2027] so no alert goes missing during the switch, and test one alert to each phone first.
